mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,task_id,source_item_id AS item_id,source_version_id AS version_id, source_version_number AS number,source_title AS title,source_kind AS kind,ordinal FROM ai_card_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,target_card_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_card_draft_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT s.task_id,s.source_item_id AS item_id,s.source_version_id AS version_id, s.source_version_number AS number,s.source_title AS title,s.source_kind AS kind,s.ordinal, CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL OR v.id IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.status='ARCHIVED' THEN 'ARCHIVED' WHEN i.status<>'ACTIVE' THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN i.current_version_id=s.source_version_id THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'SUPERSEDED' END AS state FROM ai_card_draft_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=s.owner_id AND i.id=s.source_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.source_item_id AND v.id=s.source_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.task_id,s.ordinal
